correctness.rationale: PASS: The uniform fixed point S*=c/r, r=(1+exp(b−5c))^-1 follows from simultaneous updates. Fourier diagonalization of eight distinct Moore neighbors gives mu_jk=((1+2cos X)(1+2cos Y)−1)/8 ∈[-1/2,1]. Differentiation gives J_a=[[1−r,−c/r],[5r²(1−r),d a]], T=1−r+d a, D=d[r+(1−r)a]. The three strict Jury expressions reduce to 1−D>0 and 1+T+D>0 because 1−T+D=r[1+d(1−a)]>0 for physical a<=1. Solving gives exactly −1/d−r/(2−r)<a<(d^-1−r)/(1−r). For d<1 every physical mode is stable; for d>1 the immutable uniform a=1 is unstable. For r=1/4,d=3,mu=−1/2 the limits a=1/9 and a=−10/21 yield p in (16/27,62/63), with only the transverse block stable. Independently checked 60 rational Jury/block inequalities, the exact endpoints, and the boundary eigenvalues. No nonlinear global stability was inferred.
